newsitem.title: UK: British Energy gains on positive comment.
newsitem.headline: British Energy gains on positive comment.

text.p: Shares in nuclear electricity generator British Energy touched a new high for the year on Friday, helped by favourable press comment in the wake of its half-year results released on Thursday, dealers said.
British Energy rose as high as 146p before easing to 145p by 0925 GMT, up 10-1/2p. Over 1.9 million shares had changed hands.
Dealers said the shares were boosted by a favourable write-up in the Financial Times' Lex column, which hailed the company's cash generating strength and said the shares "still have a certain glow".
